entities.name: Mindaugas & the Kingdom of Lithuania
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Mindaugas unified Lithuanian tribes, defeated rivals, and accepted Christian baptism to be crowned King of Lithuania (6 July 1253). His assassination (1263) and Lithuania's return to paganism. The only crowned king in Lithuanian history.
